report.status_line: Caution: Main water tank empty, water heater not heating, and ATVs 3 and 5 fail to start.

concerns.title: Main Water Tank Empty and Water Heater Failure
concerns.detail: The crew reported that the main water tank is empty and requested tank refueling at the earliest convenience. The static tank is at ¼, and the water heater was checked but water is still not heating up. No total water volume estimate has been provided yet.

concerns.title: ATVs 3 and 5 Inoperable
concerns.detail: The crew reported that ATVs 3 and 5 are not starting, which may impact field mobility and planned extravehicular activities.

crew_actions: Measure and report an estimate of total water on hand in litres.
Troubleshoot ATVs 3 and 5 starting issues, checking battery terminals and fuel lines.
Follow guidance from Mission Support on how to check equipment fuel levels.
Inspect water heater connections and circuit breakers.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Coordinate water resupply for the habitat.
decisions_for_earth.why: The crew reported that the main water tank is empty and requested refueling at the earliest convenience.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or decline the morning EVA requested for January 13, 2015.
decisions_for_earth.why: The commander requested approval for a four-person morning EVA while ATVs 3 and 5 are currently not starting.

report.message_to_earth: Habitat status is caution due to the main water tank running empty. On 2015-01-12, the crew reported the main water tank is empty, with the static tank reading ¼. The crew checked the water heater, inspected habitat systems, and requested tank refueling. ATVs 3 and 5 fail to start and the water heater is not heating, while diesel is at 75% and propane is at 45%. Mission Control must coordinate water resupply and approve the four-person EVA planned for the morning of January 13, 2015. Next update will follow tomorrow.
